live_subselection_memory_2026_11_05.scope: R1a subselection: live CPU ownership of slots and nested paths, allocated-only transfer between same-account/class guards, phased old/new slots and input-path materialization, removal/drop without stale capture double charge
live_subselection_memory_2026_11_05.verification: 601 distinct passed/7 ignored/0 failed: core 325 includes allocated-transfer 2; subselection 3; app/native/GPU groups documented. GPU 29/no SKIP, native STL 60; no new release/desktop/RSS measurements.
live_subselection_memory_2026_11_05.remaining: Workspace/path/recent/pending/high-water R1a and caller/query/peer/retired R1b remain. Native peak, UI export, P1-P5, GPU batching and STL/3DM accuracy gates remain open; allocation ownership does not certify process RSS or native safety.

presentation_weak_allocation_lifetime_20.scope: Separate presentation Scene storage from its Weak-retained block and share one allocation allowance through cached Weak/strong reader lifetimes; prune expired predecessor before successor admission
presentation_weak_allocation_lifetime_20.verification: Reproduced expired Weak undercharge red to green. Final 176 distinct passes/1 opt-in measurement ignored; GPU 29/no SKIP. Three new empty-template fixtures plus exact lifecycle/metadata checks.
presentation_weak_allocation_lifetime_20.remaining: Only presentation allocation ownership. Cache containers/pool, auxiliary/peer/retired/query owners, native/RSS, UI export, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open. Incremental buffer-chain leakage was not reproduced and is not claimed fixed.

external_memory_refusal_provenance_2026_.scope: One historical final refusal for external reservations/grow, captured under admission lock with actual operands/headroom and coordinator origin; successful eviction retries do not publish a refusal
external_memory_refusal_provenance_2026_.verification: 440 distinct passes, GPU 29/no SKIP; real external-admission failure operands and successful retry semantics tested. Dev MCP binary returns 9 replies with unchanged Point state and additive refusal/origin fields.
external_memory_refusal_provenance_2026_.remaining: Only external reservation/grow entrypoints. Other retained/publication/recheck/codec/native/job provenance, full owner attribution, bounded UI/logging, native/RSS, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open. An allocation refusal is not a verdict that a CAD command failed.

on_demand_memory_diagnostics_2026_11_05.scope: Read-only storage/probe diagnostics via core and om9_memory MCP, including overage, unknown states, pending/materialized and independent physical/commit request observations
on_demand_memory_diagnostics_2026_11_05.verification: 452 distinct final tests passed, 29 GPU/no SKIP; dev binary --mcp returned 9 replies with unchanged Point fixture and measured Windows RAM/commit. Read-only/overage/error states covered.
on_demand_memory_diagnostics_2026_11_05.remaining: No full R1/native/RSS bound. Known storage inventory is synchronous on demand, so large-model/nonblocking UI remains unverified; actual failed-request/codec attribution, missing owners, exact Undo age, UI export, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open. Running desktop/connector was not updated.

account_root_weak_document_memory_2026_1.scope: Admit active shared-account fixed roots at startup; count expired external Document Weak blocks once and retire expired validation proofs without retaining historical metadata peaks
account_root_weak_document_memory_2026_1.verification: Three regressions red to green; final core 312 (retained 104 included), 641 distinct total passes/7 ignored across selected current-source checks. No GPU SKIP.
account_root_weak_document_memory_2026_1.remaining: Fixed roots of current shared account and known Weak/proof ownership only. Retired account handles, peer/journal/auxiliary/query owners, diagnostics, native envelope, UI export, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open; no RSS or whole-process memory bound.

picking_cache_recency_qos_2026_11_05.scope: Shared picking cache admission reclaims unused quotas before warm arenas, tracks interactive read recency in the existing weak index, and gives render bounds a nonallocating passive read path
picking_cache_recency_qos_2026_11_05.verification: Two policy regressions red to green; 15 managed tests/16 canonical 200-point fixtures; 263 distinct final passes and 1 ignored, including 29 GPU offscreen. No adapter SKIP.
picking_cache_recency_qos_2026_11_05.remaining: CPU cache policy and offscreen publication evidence only. Normal close culling stays disabled; no desktop FPS improvement inferred. Model-scale churn/latency, other R1 owners/diagnostics, native envelope, UI export worker, P1-P5 and full plan remain open.

picking_cache_pressure_2026_11_05.scope: Shared-account CPU picking cache/quota pressure reclamation and automatic readmission; owned read handles retain data and leases through preview, eviction and Scene drop
picking_cache_pressure_2026_11_05.verification: Final targeted 257 passed, 1 ignored including 28 GPU offscreen; 10 managed cache tests use 11 canonical 200-point fixtures. No desktop measurement.
picking_cache_pressure_2026_11_05.remaining: CPU picking only. Near-ceiling churn/QoS, other cache and registry/peer/journal/query/auxiliary owners, native allocation envelope, UI export worker, GPU batching and release/desktop remain open. No process RSS bound or whole-plan completion.

scene_save_phase_reservations_2026_11_05.scope: Scene-owned reusable allocation phase/recheck and per-stage Save reservation on shared account; concurrent peer and phase-refusal history preservation tested
scene_save_phase_reservations_2026_11_05.limitations: R1 remains open for automatic pressure eviction/re-admission, optional pending arena quota retention, query/auxiliary/native owners and diagnostics. Save decoder scratch remains estimated pending within each phase; no current release/desktop or allocator/RSS bound. Captured/detached STL still reserve all remaining headroom; P1-P5 open.

system_commit_admission_2026_11_05.scope: System-commit admission/recheck under shared reservation lock, adopted-peer coverage and retained physical ceiling on commit refusal
system_commit_admission_2026_11_05.limitations: Point-in-time Windows probe and managed estimates, not a process/native memory cap; full owner inventory and diagnostics remain open.

transaction_clone_pending_transfer_2026_.scope: Clone reservation transfers both managed and pending phase totals into the registered candidate under shared locks, preserving both totals on refusal
transaction_clone_pending_transfer_2026_.limitations: Not full process/native accounting, commit headroom, metadata ownership or desktop evidence.

validation_independent_structural_limits.scope: Validate node and point quotas independently per document without subtracting retained versions; preserve shared byte accounting
validation_independent_structural_limits.limitations: Representative desktop and complete live owner accounting remain open.

multiple_document_structural_quotas_2026.scope: Apply point and node quotas independently per document while maintaining the shared byte budget
multiple_document_structural_quotas_2026.limitations: Small two-document fixture only; release, real desktop and process-memory measurements remain open

per_document_history_node_limit_2026_11_.scope: Retained document versions use individual node limits while their memory bytes remain charged; large synthetic geometry edit and Undo/Redo tested
per_document_history_node_limit_2026_11_.limitations: No representative desktop or measured process peak; other structural counters and owner accounting remain open

interactive_ram_transition_startup_2026_.scope: Use the physical-RAM-derived interactive limit for startup and retained New/Open policy
interactive_ram_transition_startup_2026_.limitations: Full P0, real large history and native memory accounting remain open

open_document_account_race_2026_11_03.scope: Recheck coordinator open-document retained and candidate peak under shared account locks before publication; preserve Redo on refusal.
open_document_account_race_2026_11_03.limitations: Application replacement path, preparation lifetime reservations, physical/native/GPU memory and 256 MiB default remain open.

transaction_ram_publication_recheck_2026.scope: Recheck shared memory admission after the commit guard and serialize reservation policy through publication.
transaction_ram_publication_recheck_2026.limitations: Tested commit path only; preparation/other-operation races, complete allocation ownership, 256 MiB limit and desktop/performance remain open.

retained_sampled_ceiling_2026_11_03.scope: Retain the tightest valid sampled RAM ceiling across shared external-account reservations and apply the constrained limit before relevant held transaction data.
retained_sampled_ceiling_2026_11_03.limitations: Only learned after an explicit sample; cross-thread policy-tightening races, unaccounted owners, native peak, free-RAM freshness and interactive 256 MiB ceiling remain open.

sampled_external_reservation_ceiling_202.scope: When an external reservation provides a physical-memory sample, check retained owners and proposed reservations against at most 60% of total RAM as well as free headroom.
sampled_external_reservation_ceiling_202.limitations: Only sampled external reservation calls; the interactive 256 MiB ceiling, other owners, actual native peaks and session-wide 60% enforcement remain open.

shared_external_capture_resource_2026_11.scope: Deduplicate immutable resource payloads shared between external captured documents and coordinator-retained document versions.
shared_external_capture_resource_2026_11.limitations: Repeated per-document aliases, other shared owners, the 256 MiB ceiling and complete 60% policy remain open; performance unmeasured.

shared_resource_admission_2026_11_03.scope: Coordinator retained document and Undo versions deduplicate shared immutable resource payloads in aggregate admission.
shared_resource_admission_2026_11_03.limitations: External capture overlap, repeated per-document aliases, other shared owners, the 256 MiB ceiling and complete RAM policy remain open.

undo_ram_cap_inventory_2026_11_02.scope: 50% physical RAM ceiling with Windows discovery, 100 MB conservative tracked-growth inventory and cached settings statistics
undo_ram_cap_inventory_2026_11_02.limitations: Existing 256 MB aggregate hard admission remains; GPU budget and 512 MB geometry checkpoints are planned only; desktop/release acceptance open

undo_memory_policy_2026_11_02.scope: Soft Undo RAM retention with minimum steps, shared-owner accounting and persisted Options UI
undo_memory_policy_2026_11_02.limitations: Hard admission limits still apply; default-feature debug and headless tests do not close desktop or release acceptance

command_options_crate_2026_11_02.scope: Extracted the existing command option parser into a Rust crate; application re-exports its existing path. No feature completion status promoted.

plugin_sdk_v1.scope: Versioned native SDK consumer; host-owned atomic document/scene publication; exact simple polyline cache/picking. Does not close the full module.
limitations: 2 unrelated broad app dock reset regressions remain failing

sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Transaction/command host đã nhận plugin; bổ sung registry, context và sessions theo hợp đồng API và audit tại owner/document, units và attributes/command/input/UI.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Plugin command feedback: Host::progress/warning stage bounded one-line reports and the Controller emits them as Progress/Warn events in the existing command EventLog, so the Command line and observers read plugin feedback through the same surface as built-in commands. Reports create no transaction or Undo entry; a refused invocation publishes nothing, reports included.
l3_open: interactive prompts and point/object input sessions
option tokens, preview overlays and dynamic menu registration
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Only reporting is exported. A refused command discards its reports because a failed invocation publishes nothing.

sdk_export_plan_policy.rule: Chỉ bề mặt plugin cần (dữ liệu/sự kiện/hành động) mới vào SDK v1; kernel hình học, UI và adapter host nội bộ không vào SDK.
sdk_export_plan_policy.applies_to: L3 files of this owner that have a recorded SDK slice
